text:
I wrote `src/app/app.ts`, `src/app/main.ts` and `public/index.html`. Typecheck and drift detection both come back clean.

- **Database:** The design has no database node, so `createApp()` takes no parameter. The two repositories still need a `DatabaseSync`, so it opens an in-memory one itself. Data is lost on every restart. If you want a file-backed database, the design needs a database node first.
- **Routes:** There is one route per controller method under `/api`, plus `GET /health` registered before the others. Admin routes read the token from the `x-admin-token` header.
- **Error handling:** An error whose message ends with "not found" returns 404. Every other thrown error returns 400.
- **Page:** The page uses `fetch` and shows data with `textContent`. It covers saving your identity, checking availability and booking, listing, cancelling and changing your bookings, viewing a room's schedule, and admin login with room management.
- **Class fix:** `RoomService.addRoom` generated its own string room id, but `RoomRepository.save` treats any non-empty id as an update. Every room creation failed with "not found". It now passes an empty id so the repository assigns one.
- **Admin password:** `AdminAuthService` reads `ADMIN_PASSWORD` and rejects every login if it is unset, so set it before starting the server.

I did not start the server or call the routes, so none of this has been run.
